beats.event: Failing every class but English; expelled from Pencey Prep
Writes a composition for roommate Stradlater
Learns Stradlater's date is Jane, whom he adores
Fights Stradlater and is easily beaten
Fed up with the phonies, catches a train to New York alone
Bad night with the prostitute Sunny and pimp Maurice
Sneaks home and wakes his little sister Phoebe
Shares his catcher-in-the-rye fantasy with Phoebe
Wakes at Mr. Antolini's to find him patting his head; flees
Arranges to meet Phoebe to say goodbye before leaving
Watches Phoebe on the carousel; they reconcile
Alludes to getting sick and being sent to a sanatorium
